exact_identity.r1_failure_assessment: FAIL_CLOSED_M45_WIDTH_INTERFACE_NAME; no partial result was admitted

static_semantic_audit.same_cycle_definition: process_events(now) forwards only an exact task whose commit_time == now
static_semantic_audit.late_event_rule: commit_time < now increments late_commit_events_rejected and is not inserted into commit_bus_tasks
static_semantic_audit.dependency_reasoning: M92 builds the frozen canonical DAG before reselection; M91 permits left only when canonical left, the frozen DAG always contains the spatial up edge, and timesteps execute sequentially. The source gate is nevertheless a literal True rather than a dynamic edge counter.
static_semantic_audit.commit_event_payload: (commit_time, task) only; no vector value is represented

unmodeled_required_logic: exact-tag compare against currently committing spatial parent
2304-bit bypass selection into one or more destination contexts
broadcast wire load and context write enables for multiple children
definition and hold/capture of vector data at the commit-end boundary
timing impact on the parent writeback and destination accumulator paths
hardware_attack_assessment.why_hits_do_not_translate_to_cycles: Most parent reads are not on the integrated critical path or overlap other calendars. Removing 1403656 reads saves only 34968 explicitly classified parent-wait cycles, or one wait cycle per 40.14 hits.
hardware_attack_assessment.why_source_regresses: Earlier task readiness perturbs the greedy resident/prepared set. The candidate creates 124960 more fusion groups; despite 286216 fewer logical updates and 202816 fewer unique weight issues, bank-conflict group duration adds 58184 source cycles.
hardware_attack_assessment.performance_value: NO_GO: 0.1049 percent integrated improvement is below the frozen 0.25 percent gate before any selector, route, wire, or frequency cost.
hardware_attack_assessment.energy_value: UNRESOLVED: the abstract ledger removes 404252928 bytes of parent-read payload, but neither SRAM-read energy nor the 2304-bit bypass-wire energy is characterized.

findings.title: M92 misses both predeclared performance gates
findings.evidence: Source cycles regress by 58184 in every sample. Integrated cycles improve by only 79632 or 0.104874 percent, leaving the candidate 110196 cycles above the frozen 0.25-percent gate.
findings.impact: The candidate is not promotable even under its own optimistic transaction model.
findings.minimal_fix: Do not weaken the gate. Replace the mechanism or add an independently predeclared source-cycle improvement that closes the full 110196-cycle shortfall without per-sample regressions.

findings.title: The model forwards a task ID, not the 2304-bit committed vector
findings.evidence: commit_events stores only (commit_time, task). A hit sets parent_end=now and removes the SRAM read; there is no payload object, capture point, data-valid phase, bypass latency, or proof that the vector remains available until the destination context consumes it.
findings.impact: The zero-latency and zero-additional-storage assumptions may not be implementable at the modeled cycle boundary.
findings.minimal_fix: Before revisiting promotion, write a cycle-accurate token contract for writeback data valid/capture and model at least one registered 2304-bit route or prove an existing context register captures the live bus without extending timing.

findings.title: Tag, broadcast, mux, wire, and timing costs are all free in a result with only 0.1049-percent margin
findings.evidence: The existing parent vector is 96 lanes by 24 bits, or 2304 bits. The model has no commit-bus capacity/fanout calendar, tag-compare delay, route energy, context fanout, or frequency penalty, while one parent-wait cycle is saved only per 40.14 hits.
findings.impact: A small frequency or wiring penalty can erase the transaction-model gain; implementation is not justified for performance.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep this as an energy-only hypothesis unless a narrow metadata/data partition or registered local route demonstrates positive post-STA performance and post-PTPX energy.

findings.title: Two safety gates are literals rather than independently measured counters
findings.evidence: new_dependency_edges_equal_zero and additional_vector_payload_storage_bytes_equal_zero are assigned True. Static control flow supports the frozen-DAG claim and the transaction model stores no vector payload, but it does not prove the physical zero-storage statement.
findings.impact: Future source changes could preserve the booleans while violating the intended hardware contract.
findings.minimal_fix: Derive dependency-edge differences from the selected-parent ledger and derive payload storage from an explicit data-token/resource model.

findings.title: The passing p95 gate has weak tail resolution
findings.evidence: With ten samples, nearest-rank p95 is rank ten and therefore exactly the maximum: 7760888 versus M91 7769480.
findings.impact: The 8592-cycle p95 improvement is cohort-specific and not a robust workload-tail claim.
findings.minimal_fix: Retain the exact ten-window gate for regression, but do not label it deployment p95; expand sequences/densities before a paper tail claim.

findings.title: The 1.0774-percent combined improvement over M89 K6 is not an M92 promotion path
findings.evidence: M91 itself missed its frozen one-percent M89 gate by 20270 cycles, and M92 independently misses its incremental source and 0.25-percent gates. The receipt correctly labels the M89 comparison as non-overriding.
findings.impact: Promoting the stacked number would launder two failed predeclared gates into one passing headline.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep M89 only as context and require M92 to pass every frozen M92 self-gate.

next_minimum_hardware_performance_direct.recommendation: Do not implement the 2304-bit commit bypass. Screen a metadata-only, bank-cycle-monotonic K6 grouping/admission rule over the existing 16 resident descriptors.
next_minimum_hardware_performance_direct.mechanism: Use a bounded two-seed or critical-bank lower-bound lookahead and reject any admission choice that increases the fused bank_issue_cycles. Preserve M91 parent SRAM behavior while targeting fewer fusion groups and lower source cycles.
next_minimum_hardware_performance_direct.why_this_is_minimal: M92 exposes a 124960-group scheduling perturbation and a 58184-cycle source loss; fixing group quality uses existing descriptor masks and avoids a new 2304-bit data route.
next_minimum_hardware_performance_direct.predeclared_gate: source cycles <= 69211896, integrated cycles <= 75740988, each sample integrated non-regression, then only a small metadata arbiter RTL/DC/STA proof
